talk.transcript: Today, we will discuss the concept of sustainable development. Sustainable development refers to meeting the needs of the present without compromising the ability of future generations to meet their own needs. It involves a balanced approach to economic growth, environmental protection, and social equity. By adopting sustainable practices, we can ensure that resources are available for future generations while maintaining a healthy planet. Examples include renewable energy, waste reduction, and sustainable agriculture. Therefore, it is crucial that we prioritize strategies that promote sustainability in our communities and economies.
